column1: #   - Settlement = When Cashfree transfers money to organizer's bank account
#   - Reconciliation = Daily verification that payment was actually received by Cashfree
#   - totalPaidByUser: Total amount customer paid (includes all fees)
#   - gatewayPaymentAmount: Amount received by Cashfree from customer
#   - basePrice: Organizer's share before gateway fees (after coupon discount)
#   - couponCode: Discount coupon applied by user (if any)
#   - originalPriceBeforeCoupon: Base price before coupon was applied
#   - settlementAmount: Final amount transferred to organizer's bank
#   - cashfreeServiceCharge: Cashfree processing fee (1.2% of order amount)
#   - cashfreeServiceTax: GST charged on Cashfree's processing fee
#   - cashfreeTotalDeducted: Total amount deducted by Cashfree (charge + tax)
#   - orderId: Cashfree order ID for verification
#   - reconciliationStatus: verified = Payment confirmed with Cashfree API
#   - lastReconciliationDate: When we last verified this payment with Cashfree
